posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked:
Let's try to anticipate the major issues. 

1) Get a list of how many people want a part, so that a script can be made.

2) Write the script.

3) Have each actor record each of their lines.

4) Combine the lines into a single audion file, and add sound effects (Is there an easy way to do this part? Does anyone already know how?)

This is probably an oversimplification, but I just wanted a starting point.
